title: Choose a Windows Control-Node Setup
objective: Choose between WSL and a Linux VM for running Ansible from a Windows workstation.

paragraphs: Ansible's control node expects a Unix-like environment. On Windows, WSL provides a convenient Linux userspace with access to Windows files and networking.
When WSL is unavailable or stronger isolation is desirable, run an Ubuntu virtual machine, connect to it, install Ansible there, and keep project files in version control.
These choices concern the control node. Windows managed nodes are a separate topic and commonly use WinRM with Windows-specific modules.
explanation.rule: Run the control node in a supported Linux environment and keep its setup reproducible.
